reference.description: Independent publisher word-region text in a reviewed derived order. This is a partial image reference, not exhaustive full-image gold; text-only outputs do not establish region accuracy.

headlineMetric: Primary word-region recognition/localization accuracy is unavailable: outputs contain text without coordinates, and the publisher annotations are not an exhaustive full-image transcription. Text presence can match incidental duplicates outside annotated regions.

evaluation.referenceOrdering: Reviewed derived convention; not official TextOCR gold reading order
